arxiv-2108-05498.title: Influence of Electromagnetic Field on Hyperbolically Symmetric Source
arxiv-2108-05498.creator: M. Z. Bhatti, Z. Yousaf, Z. Tariq
arxiv-2108-05498.description: Abstract We pursue a coherent analysis of hyperbolically symmetric static sources by extending the work of Herrera [ 32 ] to the case of electromagnetic field. We deeply analyze the impact of such a force on the physical characteristics of the hyperbolically symmetric spacetime under consideration.

arxiv-2202-10220.title: Maximum principle for time-fractional parabolic equations with a reaction coefficient of arbitrary sign
arxiv-2202-10220.creator: Natalia Kopteva
arxiv-2202-10220.description: Abstract We consider time-fractional parabolic equations with a Caputo time derivative of order α ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \alpha\in(0,1) . For such equations, we give an elementary proof of the weak maximum principle under no assumptions on the sign of the reaction coefficient.

arxiv-2205-10634.title: New quality measures for quadrilaterals and new discrete functionals for grid generation Publication type: RESEARCH ARTICLE
arxiv-2205-10634.creator: González Flores, Guilmer*, Barrera Sánchez, Pablo, G. González Flores, P. Barrera Sánchez
arxiv-2205-10634.description: Abstract In this paper, we review some grid quality metrics [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] and define some new quality measures for quadrilateral elements. Usually, a maximum value of a quality measure corresponds to the minimum value of the energy density over the grid [ 6 ] .

arxiv-2205-14559.title: The Buffon’s needle problem for random planar disk-like Cantor sets Thanks: AV is supported by NSF grants DMS 1900286 and DMS 2154402
arxiv-2205-14559.creator: Dimitris Vardakis, Alexander Volberg
arxiv-2205-14559.description: Abstract . We consider a model of randomness for self-similar Cantor sets of finite and positive 1 1 -Hausdorff measure. We find the sharp rate of decay of the probability that a Buffon needle lands δ \delta -close to a Cantor set of this particular randomness.

arxiv-2206-14866.title: iEmoTTS: Toward Robust Cross-Speaker Emotion Transfer and Control for Speech Synthesis based on Disentanglement between Prosody and Timbre Thanks: Guangyan Zhang and Tan Lee are with the DSP & Speech Technology Laboratory, Department of Electronic Engineering, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Ho
arxiv-2206-14866.creator: Guangyan Zhang, Ying Qin, Wenjie Zhang, Jialun Wu, Mei Li, Yutao Gai, Feijun Jiang, Tan Lee
arxiv-2206-14866.description: Abstract The capability of generating speech with a specific type of emotion is desired for many human-computer interaction applications. Cross-speaker emotion transfer is a common approach to generating emotional speech when speech data with emotion labels from target speakers is not available for model training. This paper presents a novel cross-speaker emotion transfer system named iEmoTTS.

arxiv-2212-08950.title: Beyond the C: Retargetable Decompilation using Neural Machine Translation PubID: pubid: Workshop on Binary Analysis Research (BAR) 2022 24 April 2022, San Diego, CA, USA ISBN 1-891562-76-2 https://dx.doi.org/10.14722/bar.2022.23009 www.ndss-symposium.org
arxiv-2212-08950.creator: Iman Hosseini, Brendan Dolan-Gavitt
arxiv-2212-08950.description: Abstract The problem of reversing the compilation process, decompilation, is an important tool in reverse engineering of computer software. Recently, researchers have proposed using techniques from neural machine translation to automate the process in decompilation. Although such techniques hold the promise of targeting a wider range of source and assembly languages, to date they have primarily targeted C code.

arxiv-2308-13947.title: Homotopy groups of quasi-spheres and applications to indefinite orthogonal groups
arxiv-2308-13947.creator: Xiangjia Kong, Reese Lance, and Franklin Rea
arxiv-2308-13947.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xiangjia Kong, Reese Lance, and Franklin Rea. In this note, we present a new proof of the isomorphism π 1 ​ ( S ​ O + ​ ( p , q ) ) ≅ π 1 ​ ( S ​ O ​ ( p ) ) × π 1 ​ ( S ​ O ​ ( q ) ) \pi_{1}(SO^{+}(p,q))\cong\pi_{1}(SO(p))\times\pi_{1}(SO(q)) using the long exact sequence associated to a fibration.

arxiv-2311-15451.title: Uncertainty-aware Language Modeling for Selective Question Answering
arxiv-2311-15451.creator: Qi Yang, Shreya Ravikumar, Fynn Schmitt-Ulms, Satvik Lolla, Ege Demir, Iaroslav Elistratov, Alex Lavaee, Sadhana Lolla, Elaheh Ahmadi, Daniela Rus, Alexander Amini, Alejandro Perez
arxiv-2311-15451.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Qi Yang, Shreya Ravikumar, Fynn Schmitt-Ulms, Satvik Lolla, Ege Demir, Iaroslav Elistratov, Alex Lavaee, Sadhana Lolla, Elaheh Ahmadi, Daniela Rus, Alexander Amini, Alejandro Perez. We present an automatic large language model (LLM) conversion approach that produces uncertainty-aware LLMs capable of estimating uncertainty with every prediction. Our approach is model- and data-agnostic, is computationally-efficient, and does not rely on external models or systems.

arxiv-2401-06572.title: A rigidity result for coisotropic submanifolds in contact geometry
arxiv-2401-06572.creator: Stephane Geudens, Alfonso G. Tortorella
arxiv-2401-06572.description: Abstract . We study coisotropic deformations of a compact regular coisotropic submanifold C C in a contact manifold ( M , ξ ) (M,\xi) . Our main result states that C C is rigid among nearby coisotropic submanifolds whose characteristic foliation is diffeomorphic to that of C C .

arxiv-2406-00300.title: Coded Computing for Resilient Distributed Computing: A Learning-Theoretic Framework
arxiv-2406-00300.creator: Parsa Moradi, Behrooz Tahmasebi, Mohammad Ali Maddah-Ali
arxiv-2406-00300.description: Abstract Coded computing has emerged as a promising framework for tackling significant challenges in large-scale distributed computing, including the presence of slow, faulty, or compromised servers. In this approach, each worker node processes a combination of the data, rather than the raw data itself. The final result then is decoded from the collective outputs of the worker nodes.

arxiv-2406-13335.title: AI-Empowered Multiple Access for 6G: A Survey of Spectrum Sensing, Protocol Designs, and Optimizations
arxiv-2406-13335.creator: Xuelin Cao, Bo Yang, Kaining Wang, Xinghua Li, Zhiwen Yu, , Chau Yuen, , Yan Zhang, , Zhu Han
arxiv-2406-13335.description: Abstract With the rapidly increasing number of bandwidth-intensive terminals capable of intelligent computing and communication, such as smart devices equipped with shallow neural network models, the complexity of multiple access for these intelligent terminals is increasing due to the dynamic network environment and ubiquitous connectivity in 6G systems.

arxiv-2407-06413.title: Disentangling sources of momentum fluctuations in Xe+Xe and Pb+Pb collisions with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2407-06413.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . High-energy nuclear collisions create a quark-gluon plasma, whose initial condition and subsequent expansion vary from event to event, impacting the distribution of the event-wise average transverse momentum ( P ⁡ ( [ p T ] ) P([p_{\mathrm{T}}]) ). Disentangling the contributions from fluctuations in the nuclear overlap size (geometrical component) and other sources at a fixed size (intrinsic component) remains a challenge.

arxiv-2503-19360.title: Realizing a topological diode effect on the surface of a topological Kondo insulator
arxiv-2503-19360.creator: Jiawen Zhang, Zhenqi Hua, Chengwei Wang, Michael Smidman, David Graf, Sean Thomas, Priscila F. S. Rosa, Steffen Wirth, Xi Dai, Peng Xiong, Huiqiu Yuan, Xiaoyu Wang, Lin Jiao
arxiv-2503-19360.description: Abstract Introducing the concept of topology into material science has sparked a revolution from classic electronic and optoelectronic devices to topological quantum devices. The latter has potential for transferring energy and information with unprecedented efficiency. Here, we demonstrate a topological diode effect on the surface of a three-dimensional material, SmB 6 , a candidate topological Kondo insulator.

arxiv-2510-16736.title: Exact Nearest-Neighbor Search on Energy-Efficient FPGA Devices
arxiv-2510-16736.creator: Patrizio Dazzi, William Guglielmo, Franco M. Nardini, Raffaele Perego, Salvatore Trani
arxiv-2510-16736.description: Abstract . This paper investigates the usage of FPGA devices for energy-efficient exact k k NN search in high-dimension latent spaces. This work intercepts a relevant trend that tries to support the increasing popularity of learned representations based on neural encoder models by making their large-scale adoption greener and more inclusive.

pmc-10596342.title: Predictive performance of polygenic scores for coronary artery disease in multiple genetic ancestries
pmc-10596342.creator: L Regazzi, A Bolli, C Cadeddu, S Boccia, G Busby
pmc-10596342.description: BackgroundPolygenic scores (PGS) for coronary artery disease (CAD) measure a person's genetic liability for CAD. PGSs for CAD are generally considered sufficiently predictive in individuals of European ancestry, but their performance is attenuated in non-European ancestry groups (AGs). We collated publicly available CAD PGS and benchmarked their performance across several AGs to evaluate their utility for personalized prevention.

pmc-11504375.title: Lower Free Thyroxine Levels Are Associated with Diabetic Kidney Disease in Males with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: An Observational Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11504375.creator: Jianan Shang, Yixuan Zheng, Meng Zhang, Meng Li, Wei Qiang, Jing Sui, Hui Guo, Bingyin Shi, Mingqian He, Jae-Hyung Park, Satyesh K Sinha, Yuchen Wang
pmc-11504375.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Objectives: We aimed to explore the correlation between thyroid function and diabetic kidney disease (DKD) in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Methods: A total of 7516 T2DM patients were enrolled and grouped according to DKD status. Clinical parameters, including blood glucose parameters, thyroid function, and indicators of renal impairment, were collected and compared between the DKD and Non-DKD groups. Correlation analysis and univariate/multivariate logistic regression analyses were performed.

pmc-12489400.title: Stakeholder Perspectives on mHealth Technologies to Prevent Sitting-Acquired Pressure Injuries in Long-Term Care Facilities: Mixed Methods Study
pmc-12489400.creator: Tamara Vos-Draper, Erin Vinoski Thomas, Emily Graybill, Melissa Morrow, Kathleen A Jordan, Pamela R Manley, Sharon E Sonenblum, Amaryllis Mavragani, HelenE Owen
pmc-12489400.description: BackgroundAdults with Alzheimer disease (AD) or Alzheimer disease and related dementias (ADRD) who require a wheelchair to accommodate disease-associated decline in mobility are at elevated risk for pressure injuries. More than half of residents in long-term care (LTC) facilities in the United States experience AD or ADRD.

pmc-13214658.title: Evaluation of the Efficacy of Treatment for Convergence Insufficiency with a New Digital Mobile Platform: A Comparative Preliminary Study
pmc-13214658.creator: Alba Pina-Balofer, David P. Piñero, Miranda Buigues, Carlo Cavaliere-Ballesta, Sergio Viudes, Laurent Bataille
pmc-13214658.description: The objective of this study was to evaluate the efficacy of a novel digital platform (Visitrain VG, Alicante, Spain) as a visual rehabilitation tool for patients with convergence insufficiency (CI), in comparison with conventional in-office vision therapy (VT) supplemented with home reinforcement exercises.

pmc-13281317.title: Estimation of hemoglobin concentration at the initiation of cardiopulmonary bypass using support vector regression
pmc-13281317.creator: Harutoyo Hirano, Shun Takahashi, Tetsuya Kamei, Makoto Hibiya

pmc-13284260.title: Bridging Rare to Common Diseases: Precision Medicine and the Transforming Landscape of Pediatric Allergy and Immunology
pmc-13284260.creator: Riccardo Castagnoli, Martina Votto, Ivan Taietti, Maria Isabel Delgado‐Dolset, Rubén Fernández‐Santamaría, Martha Jimenez Freites, Mattia Giovannini, Mark Kačar, Aspasia Karavelia, Janice Layhadi, Urszula Radzikowska, Cezmi A Akdis, Mubeccel Akdis, Marketa Bloomfield, Francesco Cinetto, Antoine Desc
pmc-13284260.description: Pediatric immunological and allergic conditions represent a broad spectrum, ranging from highly prevalent polygenic disorders (e.g., food allergy, atopic dermatitis, asthma, and allergic rhinitis) to rarer monogenic primary atopic disorders. The management of these conditions has undergone a paradigm shift in recent years.

pmc-13380560.title: Dietary nitrate supplementation does not improve resistance exercise performance in resistance-trained women
pmc-13380560.creator: Sydney N Brennan, Justin M Foster, Raymond T Gerardo, Trevor J Molnar, Ryan Tran, Christopher B Sottile, Kyle S Geppert, Michael Egiazarian, Abigail F Ballhagen, Money Ghimire, John R M Renwick, Lewis A Gough, Stewart D Gonzalez, Jason D Allen, Samantha N Rowland, Stephen J Bailey, Adam Pennell, Rac
pmc-13380560.description: Dietary nitrate supplementation has been purported to enhance explosive exercise performance; however, research examining the efficacy of nitrate to improve resistance exercise performance, such as weightlifting, in women is scarce. The purpose of this study was to investigate the impact of an acute nitrate dose on neuromuscular performance during barbell back squat and bench press.

pmc-13413428.title: A Vignetting Correction Method for Remote Sensing Images Based on Low-Rank Modeling and Polynomial Fitting
pmc-13413428.creator: Xue Zhao, Zhuoyue Hu, Zhengqin Xu
pmc-13413428.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Vignetting introduces spatial radiometric nonuniformity into remote sensing images and degrades subsequent radiometric analysis, image interpretation, and calibration-related applications. To address this problem, this paper proposes a vignetting correction method based on low-rank modeling and polynomial fitting. The method constructs a multi-frame data matrix in the logarithmic domain, extracts the shared vignette component through rank-1 low-rank modeling, and further recovers a smooth vignette field through polynomial fitting. Experiments were conducted using real remote sensing images, simulated vignetted images, and star images.

pmc-13524793.creator: Shuangqing Wang, George A Sutherland, James P Pidgeon, Mateja Šmitran, David J K Swainsbury, Elizabeth C Martin, Cvetelin Vasilev, Andrew Hitchcock, Daniel J Gillard, Ravi Kumar Venkatraman, Dimitri Chekulaev, Alexander I Tartakovskii, C Neil Hunter, Jenny Clark

pmc-13570349.title: Netrin-1 suppresses CCL2-driven macrophage migration: implications for modulating vascular inflammation and aortic sinus enlargement in hyperlipidaemic mice
pmc-13570349.creator: Vasco Claro, Yanira Riffo-Vasquez, Fulye Argunhan, Albert Ferro
pmc-13570349.description: BackgroundAtherosclerosis is driven by sustained recruitment and accumulation of monocytes and macrophages within arterial walls through chemokine-mediated pathways. Netrin-1, an immunomodulatory molecule originally identified in neural development, has emerged as a potential regulator of vascular inflammation, though its precise effects on chemokine-driven leukocyte migration remain undefined.
